HELPenableMod: Enables the mod, /spd.enable also does the trick
HELPentitiesTraveling: Allows nonplayer entities to use the mod to travel
HELPenablePlatform: Creates a platform to break your fall if air is under you when traveling between dimensions
HELPentitiesSpawnPlatform: Entities spawn the platform when they travel
HELPveilMantle: Enables an item called the Veil Mantle that can prevent teleporting between dimensions
HELPdestroyBlocks: Destroys the block at your feet and head when you travel if you would suffocate in it (excluding ladders and such)
HELPteleportationThreshold: How close you have to be to the border of the dimension to teleport (Default: 6)
HELPteleportationDistance: How many blocks away from the border you teleport to (Default: 8) DO NOT SET THIS VALUE LOWER THAN THE THRESHOLD
HELPentityTravelDistance: For performance reasons, entities will not always travel to other dimensions, they will only travel when they are within a certain amount of blocks from you, which is this number (Default: 10)
HELPportalProtection: How many ticks (20 ticks equals 1 second) you become immune to all damage after switching dimensions, useful for slower computers (Default: 40)
HELPdimensions: minecraft:overworld*-65!320? is how you format dimensions, with the dimension name, minimum and maximum of the dimension (Find values with /spd.height), ALWAYS END THE LIST WITH A DOLLAR SIGN ($)
tutorialExample: A full tutorial can be viewed on the mod page via the notion link
